messages:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] realtime streaming p99 exceeded SLO in us-west · p95=0.6s p99=2.8s · incident_id=INC-20260317-48 · grafana: https://grafana.redwood/streams/?orgId=1&panelId=99 :rotating_light:
Riley Cheng: ack oncall, I'm on it — pulling dashboards now, joining bridge · starting quick triage
Maria Gomez: customer impact? any dropped connections or error spike visible?
Samir Patel: quick query: recent 5m error rate normal, but kv_cache_eviction_rate spiked ~3000rpm at 16:03 UTC — looks correlated with p99 bump
Devon Lee: any recent rollout or config change for prefix caching or autoscaler? I see a small daemonset bump rolled 15:58 UTC (hash abc1234)
Elena Park: if eviction is the culprit, fallback: route 25% traffic to streaming-variant-v1.2 (longer kv retention, slightly higher cost) and hold autoscaler at current target 
Riley Cheng: ops, can we start route-shift 25% -> fallback? post command snippet please
ops-bot: runbook step: to shift, execute: `./infra route shift --service streaming-api --from us-west --to eu-west --pct 25 --dry-run=false` (monitors will track response)
Riley Cheng: running shift now — `./infra route shift ...` (started 16:07:12 UTC)
Samir Patel: quick prometheus: after shift started (1m) p99 dropped to ~1.1s, p95 stable 0.55s — kv_evictions back down to ~400rpm
Maria Gomez: good — any evidence of customer errors/resets? need to notify support to check top customers in the window 16:00-16:10
Devon Lee: logs show a burst of large-prefix cache writes from job id job-77 at 15:57, probably related to a downstream batching change in that service; rolling it back could help longer term
Elena Park: mitigation checklist: 1) route-shift 25% done, 2) hold rollout rollback for job-77, 3) increase KV cache retention TTL to reduce churn (can be config toggle)
Riley Cheng: shift completed at 16:07:30 UTC — monitoring shows p99 ~0.95s and no customer errors in the last 3m · holding and watching for 10m :eyes:
ops-bot: reminder: escalate to SRE lead if p99 >2s for 5m consecutive · paging rules applied
Samir Patel: captured snippet from edge logs during bump: `WARN stream-handler - kv-evict key=userid:.... size=1.2MB rate-limit=60ms` — suggests unusually large keys were evicted
Maria Gomez: looping in support and product to run customer impact check · @support-team please review customers with high us-west traffic in 15:55-16:10 window
Riley Cheng: I'll keep this thread updated, creating incident doc INC-20260317-48 in the tracker with mitigation steps and next actions
oncall-bot: monitoring continued · set alert: auto-close when p99 <1.2s for 10m and kv_eviction_rate <500rpm
Elena Park: plan for postmortem: reproduce eviction spike locally, add defensive trimming on large prefix writes, and add alert for sudden kv eviction spikes
Riley Cheng: thanks all — staying on watch, will hand off to SRE rotation at 16:30 if stable
ops-bot: handoff note: oncall -> night-sre at 16:30 UTC if meeting SLA conditions
Riley Cheng: closing immediate mitigation summary: route-shift applied, rollback flagged, ttl tweak proposal opened, monitoring healthy so far :white_check_mark:
